# Wait Until

Source: [wiki article 9298](../archive/9298.md); edited 2026-07-16.

Exact pinned API: [Wait Until](../../api/actions/wait-until.md).

<a id="wiki-9298-n1"></a>

- Wait Until ends when its continue predicate is true or timeout elapses; it ignores the rule's conditions during the wait.

<a id="wiki-9298-n2"></a>

- It may pass after zero ticks and has no one-tick minimum.
